modelOverview: First introduced in 1983 and named for the flexible, brick-link bracelet that echoes the fluid movement of Cartier's emblematic panther, the Panthère de Cartier was relaunched in 2017 with its distinctive square case, screwed bezel and rail-track Roman numeral dial. The Mini is the smallest proportion in the modern range, a compact quartz-powered dress watch designed to be worn alone or stacked with other Cartier jewellery pieces.

WSPA0014.materials: Stainless steel case and steel brick-link bracelet
WSPA0014.bezel: Square polished steel bezel with signature exposed screws
WSPA0014.dial: Silvered dial with Roman numerals, rail-track minute ring and blued-steel sword-shaped hands
WSPA0014.description: The Panthère de Cartier Mini in steel is the smallest expression of the collection, pairing the model's signature octagonal-screwed square case with a silvered dial, Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands, worn on Cartier's flexible steel brick-link bracelet. Its crown is set with a blue synthetic spinel, a detail carried across the modern Panthère range. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
